## Where I am

This is the project pivot, and the headline number lives elsewhere — the
go/no-go rests on the donor-pseudobulk `WT_heat` NES in the static `05_gonogo_review` notebook
(`wt_heat_nes_forest`). Here I just do the per-cell corroboration: where does the mouse 39 °C
score actually sit on the cells? I'm asking whether any high-score region is Treg-preferential
or whether it's pan-T (the NES says pan-T: Treg 2.53 ≈ Tcon 2.59 > CD8 2.07), and whether the
score shifts SF vs PB within a population. Brush the bright cells and read their label and
tissue.

```{python}
#| label: setup
import sys, os
from pathlib import Path
d = Path.cwd().resolve()
while not (d / "02_analysis/config/analysis_config.yaml").exists():
    d = d.parent
os.chdir(d); sys.path.insert(0, str(d / "02_analysis"))
from helpers.interactive_utils import load_explorer, color_key
import jscatter

df = load_explorer("05_gonogo")
print(df.shape, "cells")
df.head(3)
```

## The grid

Three linked panels — the WT_heat score, the cell state, and the tissue. Brush the brightest
(high-score) cells in panel 1 and read what they are in panels 2 and 3.

```{python}
#| label: score-triptych
opts = dict(x="x", y="y", height=360)
s_score = jscatter.Scatter(data=df, **opts); s_score.color(by="WT_heat_updown", map="magma"); s_score.legend(True)
s_lab   = jscatter.Scatter(data=df, **opts); s_lab.color(by="coarse_label", map=color_key(df, "coarse_label")); s_lab.legend(True)
s_tis   = jscatter.Scatter(data=df, **opts)
s_tis.color(by="tissue", map={"synovial_fluid": "#D55E00", "peripheral_blood": "#0072B2"}); s_tis.legend(True)
# brush the brightest WT_heat cells here -> read their label + tissue in 2 & 3
jscatter.compose(
    [(s_score, "WT_heat (up−down)"), (s_lab, "cell state"), (s_tis, "tissue")],
    sync_view=True, sync_selection=True, sync_hover=True, rows=1,
)
```

If lags, close panels
```{python}
# close panels from a previous run (ipywidgets keeps every widget alive until closed)
for _s in globals().get("PANELS", []):
    try: _s.widget.close()
    except Exception: pass
```

The high-score cells spread across both Treg and Tcon — the
per-cell view echoes the pan-T NES. Nothing jumps out as a Treg-only pocket, but per-cell
scoring is noisy so I hold this loosely.

## Channels

Same score, but with the full tooltip — hover a cell to read its up-set, down-set, and net
(`_updown` = up − down). Useful when a bright cell looks borderline and I want to see whether
the up-genes carry it or the down-genes just dropped.

```{python}
#| label: score-tooltip
s = jscatter.Scatter(data=df, x="x", y="y", height=650)
s.color(by="WT_heat_updown", map="magma")
s.legend(True)
s.tooltip(True, properties=["coarse_label", "tissue", "donor",
                            "WT_heat_up", "WT_heat_down", "WT_heat_updown"])
s.show()
```

## Decision — `decisions.go_no_go`

The headline is the pseudobulk NES, not this per-cell view — per-cell scoring is noisier, so
the effect-size contract keeps it a secondary tier and never pools it with the NES. This view
is only the sanity check on *where* the signal lives: pan-T (as the NES says) or a Treg-specific
pocket standing out. The R `05_gonogo_review` sibling records the one-line claim and branch in
`analysis_config.yaml::decisions.go_no_go`.
